show.description:
A billionaire heir walks away from power and pleasure to embrace a life of renunciation.
But when his family introduces a clever temptress to lure him back, desire collides with devotion.
Caught in a mansion of secrets, conspiracies, and forbidden emotions—will restraint survive temptation?
